description: Agent Inventory: submit reorder records with the stock levels and stated lead times they answer to: the stock on hand record with its reference, the day it is as of and each item with its stock on hand, reorder point, maximum stock, lead time in days and daily usage; each reorder with its id, reference, item, the day raised, the units reordered, its status (open, received or cancelled) and the stock on hand when raised; optionally each stockout with the item and the day it ran out. The signed report gives the stock on hand record and the reorders, each item at or below its reorder point against the open reorders for it, each stockout against the reorders raised before and after it, each reorder quantity against the usage over the stated lead time, and each reorder against the stock on hand when it was raised, and counts them, and names divergent reorder records: an item below its reorder point with no reorder raised, a reorder raised only after a stockout, a reorder quantity that ignores the stated lead time, and a reorder for an item already overstocked; then a reorder point below the usage over the lead time and a reorder for an item the stock record does not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No items, no stock on hand beside a reorder point, no stockout record, no daily usage and lead time, or no maximum stock leaves those points unverified. The usage over the lead time is the daily usage times the lead time in days; a stockout reads against the reorders raised in the thirty days before it, or over its lead time when longer; an item is overstocked at or above its maximum stock; a supplied stockout list with no rows reads as no stockout; items match by their SKU or their words, units compare to the hundredth and dates by the day. This reads whether reorders follow the reorder points and lead times the stock record sets. Verdict inventory_reorder_divergent, inventory_reorder_partial, inventory_reorder_unverified or inventory_reorder_consistent. POST /api/inventory-reorder-check. Reads the inventory records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it never moves stock, never places or cancels an order, never writes to anyone’s inventory system and never adjusts a record, which stay with the business and its staff, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Inventory reads inventory records: a stock count, receiving records, shrinkage and loss records, a stock adjustment log, an inventory valuation, reorder records, a dead stock record and consignment stock records, each against the system stock record, the purchase or consignment orders, the count and sales records, the count and the period close, the counts and purchase records, the stock levels and lead times, the movement window and period report, or the sale and settlement records it answers to. The family checks whether the stock record can be trusted; the Agent Bookkeeping family reads the ledger the stock feeds, and the boutique tools act on one store’s orders. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-inventory-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-inventory/.
